dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Welcome to Stardust Station. Jax is giving the tour; he's promised not to improvise.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I promised to show you what's here, not what's in the brochure.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: Good. I brought comfortable shoes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I'll join you for the lab portion.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: If we get lost, follow the smell of the vending-machine curry. Someone claims it's excellent.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: This is the main work area. That corner used to be open until we moved the collection bins.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: Was moving them necessary?

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: It was necessary to move them *back*. The computer had put one in Noola's turning space.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: That's the kind of change I'd rather see than a spotless demonstration.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Mira runs the lab. She's prepared a concise demonstration.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: It was concise when I started. Then the fourth sample disagreed with the first three.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: The disagreeing samples are generally the ones I ask about.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Oh. Then you're going to enjoy this.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: It has a very clear set of limits.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: And actual photographs. Sorry, I do want you to see the photographs.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: The material holds under this load and fails above this temperature. Both are repeatable here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: And you don't know what determines where the residue appears?

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Correct. We have correlations, not a recipe.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We've refused to collect personal disclosures as explanatory data.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: Then I'll judge what you can show me, not what someone wishes you'd measured.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: These are the original repair logs. Nothing has been edited to make the pilot look tidier.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: And the anonymous staff cards?

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: We didn't put them in the material record.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: People told friends things and wrote equipment complaints. Those are not the same permission.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: Good. I didn't come here to collect gossip. Though I understand you have excellent dinner parties.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: You're worried I won't appreciate how much this station does unless it looks exceptional.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I worry you'll see what headquarters sees: small numbers, high costs, and a crew that won't fit neatly in a chart.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: I've visited larger sites that looked wonderful until you asked anyone where the spare valves were.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Here everyone can tell you. They might argue about which cupboard first.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: That low-pressure alarm is real. I need this corridor for a repair.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We've got a visitor standing in the corridor.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: A corridor is for getting somewhere. Please use it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Excellent. Somebody who understands a doorway.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: We need to turn here. The manifold is ahead and Zib has the service branch isolated.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: You know the repair already?

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I know Zib's face. It's the one he makes when somebody wants to walk through the bit he has opened.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: Does he often make that face?

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Only when he's working. So, quite often.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: The branch pressure's low. I'll isolate the actuator and check the seal.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I'll take a reading after you shut it down. I won't touch your tools.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Would you rather we move the visitor to the lab?

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: I'd rather watch how you respond, if we're not in the way.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Stay behind that line and we'll get along famously.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Power isolated. Jax, hand me the driver, not the one with the worn tip.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I know which one. You complained about it at Kreeb's dinner.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I'm recording the pressure change, not the social history of your screwdriver.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Access route around the repair is clear.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: You all sound like you've done this together before.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: The arguing is optional. The competence isn't.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Hold the cover while I reseat the actuator.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I have it. Mira, stop trying to take photographs of our hands.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I'm photographing the seal.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: The isolation notice is in place.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: And the visitor route stays open at the far end.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: I appreciate not being made the most important person in this room.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Pressure is back within range.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: The return is steady. Nothing magical, just a fixed actuator.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The service branch is restored.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: You found it and repaired it without waiting for a committee.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Don't say that where Astra can hear you. She'll feel challenged.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: There's a small residue trace near the warm seam. It may be entirely incidental.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: Can you tell me anything useful about it?

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Not until I test it. And not if Zib tells me I've left fingerprints on his seal.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: You can say you don't know. I wish more scientists would.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I usually have to apologize for saying it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: I've seen a narrow material result and a much broader record of real work.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I thought you were here to evaluate the material pilot.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: I am. But I can't ignore the people who kept it safe and kept the station running.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: That's the part I never know how to put in a box.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Our last inspection report was a little unflattering.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: Many inspection reports are. The question is whether anyone corrected the problem.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: I maintained a separate case file.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: He did. Against advice.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: Did it help?

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: It helped me. The station remained mysterious.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I'm changing the introduction. The useful record here is the work the crew actually does.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I'm glad. But don't make my sample disappear because it's inconvenient to explain.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I won't. It's a genuine result with genuine limits.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Then we finally have an introduction we can both read without wincing.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: I can recommend an operating trial based on your maintenance record. The material stays an observation, not a promised output.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: That's what we've been trying to tell them.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: I can't guarantee central will listen. But I'll put my name on what I saw.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I'd be grateful.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: You can thank me after they read the part about costs.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: We've kept the original field reports, including the ones that went nowhere.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: And the crew doesn't have to perform a feeling for the pilot to count.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: You can see exactly what we measured.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: Good. I'd rather defend an unromantic truth than a very polished fiction.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Even if the unromantic truth comes with several boxes of spare parts?

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: I'll recommend continued operation while central evaluates the actual service record.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: That's the first description of this station that sounds like where I work.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: I haven't promised you a budget.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I know. I have managed to be disappointed professionally before.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: That's the correct docking hatch. The other one sticks after a long shift.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: You're a surprisingly frank guide.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I was told I had to be. The brochure is available if you'd like to read a different story.

dialogueInline.speaker: Operations Liaison
dialogueInline.text: I liked this one.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Do me a favor and don't try the curry on your way out. We have enough reports.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The Liaison's recommendation has been submitted.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I didn't expect them to be that reasonable.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: They liked the failed tests. I'm choosing to focus on that.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Central review is still pending. Should I keep the celebration cake on hold?

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: They accepted the site and added a material-output target.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: To a report that explicitly says we can't predict the output?

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Correct. They appear to have read half of it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: That's more than I usually expect, and somehow worse.
